items.question: What hotline number should people call to contact the UAE Ministry of Health and Prevention about fake or harmful medicines?
items.fact: MoHaP hotline for fake or harmful medicines is 80011111

items.question: When was the 'Tatmeen' track-and-trace digital platform for healthcare supply chains in the UAE launched by the Ministry of Health and Prevention?
items.fact: Tatmeen platform was launched by MoHaP in September 2020
